text: I can explain all-reduce as reduce-scatter plus all-gather and compute ring all-reduce traffic per rank as 2(N − 1)/N × size.
I can compute model-state memory per GPU for plain data parallelism and ZeRO stages 1, 2 and 3 from the 16-bytes-per-parameter breakdown.
I can describe the Megatron column/row split of the MLP and attention blocks and say why it needs two all-reduces per layer in forward.
I can calculate the pipeline bubble fraction (p − 1)/(m + p − 1) and compare GPipe, 1F1B and interleaved schedules on bubble and memory.
I can explain expert parallelism's two all-to-alls per MoE layer, expert capacity, and what a hot expert does to step time and dropped tokens.
I can lay out TP × PP × DP for a given cluster, justify TP inside a node with bandwidth arithmetic, and say how the choice differs for inference.
